title: Robin nullity and asymptotic geometry of the critical hyperbolic catenoid
summary: For each parameter $a>1$, the critical hyperbolic catenoid $Σ_a$ is a rotationally symmetric, free boundary minimal annulus in a geodesic ball $B^3(r(a))\subset\mathbb{H}^3$. The Morse index of $Σ_a$ is at least $4$ by Medvedev [7], who conjectures equality. In this paper we identify a new geometric and spectral phenomenon for the family $\{Σ_a\}_{a>1}$, which we call "parameter-criticality", and study its consequences for the Robin spectrum.
